study_title: SM Sith Lord JK website source review
source_credit: SM Sith Lord / COG Factory. Historical and guest contributors retain their own credits. Independent synthesis by Coda in collaboration with Andrei.
no_copying_policy: Catalog stores titles, URLs, hashes, metadata and review depth, not authored page bodies, art, COGs or game data.

frontier.unavailable_author_toolchain: The toolchain page describes unreleased workbench repositories; no unpublished generator, SED bridge or archive was claimed reviewed.
frontier.excluded: Non-JK game/app branches; third-party websites and repository histories; unpublished/private pages; binary game execution; image/video artistic review; social interaction.
frontier.limitations: This closes the observed public linked JK HTML frontier and visible feed/category indexes, not every possible unlinked URL. Search/category queries are discovery aids, not proof that no untagged historical post exists. The generation-2 draft-preview shell was encountered as a public link; no unlisted draft feed was fetched.
frontier.historical_external_downloads: Linked Massassi and JKHub downloads on the historical project pages were catalogued as references, not reacquired or executed.
